newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Graboplast seeks PVC alliance in E.Europe.
newsitem.headline: Graboplast seeks PVC alliance in E.Europe.

text.p: Hungarian home improvement product maker Graboplast Rt said on Thursday it was seeking strategic cooperation with an east European partner in PVC floor cover production.
"We see good chances in the PVC floor cover market in eastern Europe," chairman and CEO Peter Jancso told Reuters following the release of the group's January-September 1996 results.
"We are seeking a strategic alliance within eastern Europe in the area of PVC floor cover production," he said.
This would allow the group to increase its market more rapidly than otherwise and expand its product range.
Jancso also said it was close to finalising a deal which would allow the group to enter the wooden parquet floor market.

Graboplast reported a surge in its consolidated operating profits to 1.124 billion forints in the January-September period from 485.4 million in the same nine months of 1995. Its pre-tax profit soared to 1.05 billion from 359.3 million.
The group's total net sales doubled to 11.48 billion forints from 5.77 billion. Last year's data do not include figures from wallpaper firm Keszta-Dunawall Kft, which was acquired in 1996.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange Graboplast closed at a new all-time high of 5,050 forints, up 200 forints.
